response.original_title: The Real Maxx Payne's The Thing That Should Not Be
response.overview: In October 1995, Maxx Payne was working for the largest wrestling company in the world. As he left for a grueling two-week tour throughout Europe, he did something unprecedented… he brought along his video camera. What followed was a real, raw, and rare look at life on the road during one of the most challenging times in the history of the wrestling business.  Get an all-access pass to accompany the wrestlers to places once forbidden – tour buses, hotels, airports, backstage at the events, even walking to the ring. It’s a cross between an expose and the wrestling world’s first travel vlog, equal parts a nostalgic look at an era that no longer exists and a cautionary tale of the culture of the time.  See the pros and cons of pro wrestling, quite literally through the eyes and complex mind of Darryl “Maxx Payne” Peterson as he navigates attitudes, politics, long nights on the road, temptation of the dark side, and the rush of performing.
